bullets.text: AI-Powered Photo Organization - **Microsoft Photos** now features AI-driven auto-categorization for streamlined photo management.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - **Microsoft** releases Build 27954, enhancing connectivity and addressing known issues.
Unified Microsoft Marketplace - The new **Microsoft Marketplace** consolidates cloud solutions and AI apps for easier access.
AI-Enhanced Text Editing - **Microsoft Edge** introduces highlightsFromPoint() for improved text editing capabilities.
XCSSET Malware Update - **Microsoft** identifies new XCSSET variant targeting developers, enhancing awareness of evolving threats.
Empower Workforce with Agents - **Microsoft 365 Copilot** introduces agents to enhance productivity and streamline workflows.
Windows ML Now Available - **Windows ML** empowers developers to deploy AI models locally across Windows devices.
Microsoft Purview Success - **Microsoft Purview** achieves a 30% reduction in data breach likelihood for organizations.
